Placeholder, tracked in [#59](https://github.com/UBC-DSCI/reproducible-and-trustworthy-workflows-for-data-science/issues/59).

You will meet Python projects that use pip or conda, not uv.
This chapter will cover moving them to uv:

- a project with a `requirements.txt` (`uv add -r requirements.txt`, and what a requirements file does not record)
- a conda project with an `environment.yml`
  (the archived [conda chapter](9510-virtual-environments-python-conda.qmd) explains the format)
- `uv export`, for tools that still want a `requirements.txt`
- why one `uv.lock` works on every operating system
  (what the archived [conda-lock chapter](9520-virtual-environments-python-conda-lock.qmd) did with `--platform`)
